limitations.detail: app/llm.py is a deterministic template composer; is_available() is False. Anything needing real inference is refused, not faked.
Document Q&A is a keyword index (token overlap with inverse-document-frequency weighting) inside the platform sqlite file — not an embedding model.
No accounting/ERP, cloud drive or messaging connector was named by the team. None is implemented; a named one ships as a marked placeholder until built.
Email/webhook delivery needs operator-supplied credentials; without them the notification block records delivery in-process (channel mcp).
UAE VAT rate, retention and payment terms have no defaults. An unset setting is refused by name rather than guessed.
